description: This file defines a middleware class in C# for handling security headers in an ASP.NET Core application. It adds various security-related HTTP headers to responses to enhance security.

classes.name: SecurityHeadersMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware component that appends security headers to HTTP responses in an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds security-related headers to the HTTP response and proceeds to the next middleware.
